Bug_Title: MS: Public static method may expose internal representation by returning a mutable object or array (MS_EXPOSE_REP)
Bug_Details:
A public static method returns a reference to a mutable object or
 an array that is part of the static state of the class.
 Any code that calls this method can freely modify
 the underlying array.
 One fix is to return a copy of the array.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is caused by the public static method `getArray()` returning a reference to the internal static array `array`. Any code that calls this method can freely modify the underlying array, which can lead to unexpected behavior and data corruption.
Trigger_Explanation: The test cases trigger the bug by modifying the returned array in the test method.
